title: Design System: Prawal Sharma, cinematic portfolio

display.purpose: The name in the opening and the Scale figures.

label.purpose: Metadata beside or below content, and group headings.

close.purpose: Tell me what you are building. Only.

shadows.name: figure-dusk
shadows.purpose: The real photograph in the close.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: On-screen movement and lighting cues: the horizon line, the atmosphere crossfade.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: Content developing from latent with a 6px focus pull, 70ms cue stagger.

motion.name: portrait-follow
motion.purpose: The living portrait following the pointer; no overshoot.

storyBehavior.driver: useStory: discrete ScrollTrigger beats, native CSS sticky, no scroll interception or idle loop
storyBehavior.detail: Native modal dialog; background scroll lock; focus containment; Escape and close restore opener without scrolling
storyBehavior.reducedMotion: Resolved non-sticky scenes, no transitions, manual selectors retained
storyBehavior.portrait: Neutral-pitch runtime row; horizontal yaw; small vertical body/camera response; no breathing; RAF sleeps when settled

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in a view: See the work, Email Prawal.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: #1b1e22; color: #e4e1da; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-action:hover { background: #873f17; } .ds-action:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #873f17; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Résumé, LinkedIn, Read the framework.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: transparent; color: #1b1e22; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(27 30 34 / 0.2); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-ghost:hover { color: #873f17; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #873f17; } .ds-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #873f17; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Cue Rail
components.description: Chapters as numbered cues; the current cue is lit.
components.css: .ds-rail { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(27 30 34 / 0.1); background: #e4e1da; } .ds-rail a { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 0 6px 16px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #515458; text-decoration: none; transition: color 400ms ease; } .ds-rail span { width: 28px; } .ds-rail a[data-state=past] { color: #44484c; } .ds-rail a[data-state=current] { color: #1b1e22; } .ds-rail a[data-state=current] span { color: #873f17; } .ds-rail a[data-state=current]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: 5px; bottom: 5px; width: 1px; background: #873f17; } .ds-rail a:hover { color: #1b1e22; }

components.name: Patch Channel
components.description: A capability in the patch sheet; pressed lights where it was used.
components.css: .ds-channel { position: relative; display: block; min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 0 7px 16px; background: none; border: 0; text-align: left; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #44484c; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-channel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: calc(7px + 0.8em); width: 10px; height: 1px; background: #515458; transform: scaleX(0.6); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-channel[aria-pressed=true] { color: #873f17; } .ds-channel[aria-pressed=true]::before { background: #873f17; transform: none; } .ds-channel:hover { color: #1b1e22; } .ds-channel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #873f17; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Credits
components.description: Facts set like film credits: role right-aligned, value left-aligned on a shared gutter.
components.css: .ds-credits { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin: 0; background: #e4e1da; padding: 16px; } .ds-credits div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 136px 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-credits dt { text-align: right; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #515458; } .ds-credits dd { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #1b1e22; }

components.name: Story selector
components.description: Manual beat selection remains available alongside native scroll and in reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-story { min-width:44px; min-height:44px; padding:.6rem .7rem; background:transparent; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ember-ink, #873f17); color:var(--ember-ink, #873f17); font: .82rem Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-story:hover { color:var(--ink, #1b1e22); } .ds-story:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-story:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember-ink, #873f17); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Detail trigger
components.description: Opens the shared native reading dialog and restores the initiating control on close.
components.css: .ds-detail { min-height:48px; padding:.6rem 0; text-align:left; background:transparent; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-3, #515458); font:.9rem Archivo, sans-serif; color:var(--ink, #1b1e22); } .ds-detail:hover { color:var(--ember-ink, #873f17); } .ds-detail:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-detail:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember-ink, #873f17); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
A career walked through one stone building over one day. Each chapter is a lighting condition in that building (a stone hall, sand-lit rooms, a fog-lit gallery of systems, one graphite colonnade, the brightest room, a warm gallery, dusk). Nothing lamps up out of darkness: content develops, like an architect's diazo print under light, from a pale latent image into graphite ink as the light reaches it. One ember key marks the thing developed now.

The opening is a living portrait. Prawal stands in the stone hall and, on a desktop with a mouse, turns his head toward the visitor's pointer. The close returns to him at dusk in the real photograph. There is one sun, high at upper left: every plane is lit on its left face and every shadow falls right and down by the same ratio.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral grounds lit as environments, never cream paper and never plain white. One graphite passage for the numbers.
Cool graphite ink taken from the charcoal blazer; one ember accent for what is developed now.
Archivo across its width axis: expanded caps for the name and figures, standard width for reading.
Sharp corners, hairlines only where they measure, measured shadows from one sun, no glow.
Abstractions drawn as geometry (canvas and SVG), always captioned as abstractions.

rules.name: The Developed-Now Rule
rules.body: Ember marks the one thing developed at this moment. If an element would be ember whatever the visitor does, it is the wrong colour.

rules.name: The Condition Rule
rules.body: Chapters change light, not paint. A chapter's ground comes from the fixed atmosphere as a lighting cue (a registered-colour crossfade over 1.4s), never as a hard band of section colour. The only built-in ground is the graphite passage, and text never sits on its thresholds.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Light comes from upper left. Planes are lit on their left face; shadows fall right and down with one offset ratio (about 0.6 across to 1 down). A shadow in any other direction is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Labels sit beside or below what they describe, or are the heading itself. Never a small label above a heading.

rules.name: The Measured-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is cast by something, in the sun's direction. No glow, no halo, no zero-offset shadow.

rules.name: The Material-Shade Rule
rules.body: Scene-specific stone, sage and mineral colors in the token layer describe lit faces, returns, inactive routes and developed cells within the established rooms. They are intentional material shades, not new chapter palettes. Directional light washes remain translucent; they are not text colors.

rules.name: The Scene-Type Rule
rules.body: Scene headings, role captions, system narrative, framework and gallery captions, archive subjects and voices use the named type endpoints above. Their scales follow visual responsibility; they do not introduce another font or a competing global hierarchy.

dos: **Do** keep ember (#b8602e) and ember-ink (#873f17) for the one thing developed now.
**Do** keep the real photograph of Prawal in the film (the close), and judge any generated likeness against it; identity fidelity outranks spectacle.
**Do** caption every diagram as an abstraction and keep its claims to the published description.
**Do** give reduced motion a composed state: resolved scenes with manual selectors, no animated sequence or sticky run, and the neutral portrait as a still.
**Do** end the opening only on an intentional request: Skip intro, the skip link, Escape, a real wheel or trackpad scroll, or a vertical swipe.
**Do** use strong ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`) for entrances; never ease-in.
donts: **Don't** put a label above a heading.
**Don't** paint a chapter as a flat band of colour; change the light.
**Don't** use cream paper or pure white as a ground, or glow, glass or neon anywhere.
**Don't** cast a shadow in any direction but right and down.
**Don't** crossfade two different generated takes of Prawal; one source drives his face.
**Don't** count numbers up; figures switch on.
**Don't** use em or en dashes in copy.
